description: This file implements a generic infrastructure for reference iterators in a Git-related project, including various iterator types and functions for advancing, seeking, and managing reference iterators.

classes.name: ref_iterator
classes.description: Base structure for reference iterators, containing a vtable and a reference.

classes.name: empty_ref_iterator
classes.description: A simple reference iterator that is always at the end (empty).

classes.name: merge_ref_iterator
classes.description: An iterator that merges two reference iterators, with logic for selecting which to yield.

classes.name: prefix_ref_iterator
classes.description: An iterator that filters references based on a prefix, optionally trimming the prefix from the reference names.

methods.name: ref_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the reference iterator to the next reference.

methods.name: ref_iterator_seek
methods.description: Seeks the reference iterator to a specific reference name.

methods.name: ref_iterator_free
methods.description: Frees the reference iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: empty_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a new empty reference iterator.

methods.name: is_empty_ref_iterator
methods.description: Checks if a reference iterator is the empty iterator.

methods.name: merge_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a new merge reference iterator from two iterators and a selection function.

methods.name: overlay_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates an overlay iterator that combines two iterators, with optimization for empty iterators.

methods.name: do_for_each_ref_iterator
methods.description: Iterates over all references in an iterator, applying a callback function.
